title: Per-corner reference table (reference_<pair>.json)
description: Produced by trace-kit's reference extractor from logged AI laps (plus human validation laps where substituted). Stores per-metric sigma_ref only; tolerance bands are derived at run time as max(sigma_ref x EVM_source, floor), with the multipliers and floors living exclusively in controller_config.json (one source of constants). EVM is source-dependent, so each corner records whether its reference is AI or human-substituted. Corner ids must match the track's annotation file.

track.description: AC track full id (folder + layout, '-' separated) — must match the annotation file's `track` and the loaded track, or the runtime refuses the block.

car.description: AC car id (ac.getCarID) the reference laps were driven in. The reference is per CAR-track pair: bands and brake points do not transfer between cars.

track_length_m.description: AI-spline track length in metres (ac.getSim().trackLengthM) as read when the reference laps were recorded. Pinned here because every spline-to-metre conversion in the pipeline — brake-initiation distance, apex window half-width — depends on it, and the offline extractor and simulator must use the same value the runtime did.

human_driver.description: Who drove the human validation laps, as a ROLE not a name (e.g. "researcher (not a study participant)"). Published with the dataset; a researcher-driven reference is a stated limitation, not a hidden one.

setup.description: The fixed setup all reference and participant laps use, e.g. "default (car ships)" — framing v6 requires one fixed setup per pair.

lap_time_cov_pct.description: Coefficient of variation of the reference laps' times, in PERCENT, as measured at extraction. Gate G0 requires < 1%. Stored so the gate is auditable from the committed table alone rather than only from the extractor's console output at the time it ran.

source_laps.description: Provenance of the reference (documented per framing v6: 'AC AI, strength X%, n laps, fixed setup').

source.description: Whether this corner's reference comes from the AI laps or was human-substituted (recorded per Gate G0).

clean_passes.description: Clean passes of this corner across all reference blocks — the denominator the per-element counts below are out of.

braking.description: Passes a brake-initiation point was detected on. OPTIONAL: absent iff the corner has no `braking` reference (no annotated braking zone), mirroring that field.

apex.description: Passes whose apex window(s) were fully sampled and so contributed to the expert line and the RMS statistics.

corner_speed.description: Passes a minimum corner speed was found on.

contributing_laps.description: How many reference passes actually built each of this corner's three references. Gate G0 requires every corner to meet the extractor's minimum contributing-lap count (trace_kit.reference.MIN_LAPS_PER_CORNER); persisting the counts is what makes that clause checkable from the repository instead of only from the console at extraction time. A small count next to a tiny sigma_ref is the signature of a mis-fitted zone, not of a repeatable driver.

sigma_ref_m.description: Std dev of the reference laps' brake-initiation points, in metres of track length along the spline ((spline_lap - spline_mean) x track_length_m). Metres, not spline units, because the tolerance band and its floor are stated in metres.

braking.description: Expert brake-initiation point (mean over the reference laps); world_pos is where the braking marker is drawn, spline_pos is the datum the per-pass distance metric is signed against. OPTIONAL: absent iff the corner's annotation has no braking zone (corner not applicable to the braking-point element).

line.description: The expert LINE across this gate's apex window: mean reference world position sampled at regular spline steps over [gate - apex_window_half_m, gate + apex_window_half_m]. Samples are ordered along the driving direction and may wrap start/finish. The metric is RMS lateral deviation from this line over the window (framing v6), so a single gate point is not sufficient — this array is what makes the metric computable.

gates.description: One entry per apex gate in the annotation (compound corners may have several). world_pos is where the apex marker is drawn; `line` is what the metric is measured against.

mean_rms_m.description: Mean, across the reference laps, of each lap's RMS lateral deviation from the mean expert line over this corner's apex window(s). The criterion is a deviation from an ideal rather than a two-sided band about a mean, so the pass threshold is mean_rms_m + band, not |x - mean| <= band.

sigma_ref_m.description: Std dev, across the reference laps, of those per-lap RMS deviations. Same units as the per-pass metric, so band = max(sigma_ref_m x EVM_source, floor) applies directly.

apex.description: One RMS value per corner pass, taken over the union of this corner's apex windows — a compound corner with two apex gates still yields ONE apex criterion boolean.

corner_speed.description: Minimum-corner-speed envelope: mean and std dev across reference laps. A sigma of exactly 0 is legal and expected at some corners — the AC AI is consistent by construction — which is what the band FLOORS in controller_config.json exist to absorb (eval plan v2). The guard against a spuriously tiny sigma is a minimum contributing-lap count in the extractor, not a schema bound.
